verdict.rationale: Puzzle's ReadMe-hosted API reference includes a live "Try It!" console on each endpoint and generated language snippets, synced from a published OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec, so an interactive reference with runnable examples does exist. However, actually running requests needs the caller's own credentials, and both API access and sandbox credentials are granted only by emailing api@puzzle.io, so a user cannot explore runnable examples self-serve. missing for 10: self-serve or unauthenticated execution of examples, instant sandbox credentials, independent or hands-on corroboration that the console works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The ReadMe-hosted API reference ships the live "Try It!" console per endpoint
